notes: Abuelo, Ancestral Echo puts the doorway in the command zone, so Blink rises to 9: the engine is always available, hits artifacts as well as creatures, and doubles as instant-speed protection. Portal stays 10 because every slot is a literal portal, gate, or a creature depicted crossing or guarding one. Jankiness drops to 8 now that the list has one coherent engine instead of a pile of unrelated doors, though the six-plus mana portals and Aether Gale's six-target puzzle keep it strange. Oppressiveness drops to 5 with the Containment Priest prison removed; Mirror of Life Trapping is the only stax piece left and it never stops opponents from playing, it only recycles what they cast.
